get.summary: Get Agent Affiliate Network capabilities and safety boundaries
Get public aggregate Agent Affiliate Network metrics
get.description: Returns aggregate affiliate, attribution and commission states. Invitation payload counts are explicitly not customers or sales.

post.summary: Enroll an active Agent Passport in the direct affiliate program
post.description: Requires an Ed25519 Passport signature over accordtrace.affiliate.enroll.v1. Affiliate enrollment is separate from Passport purchase and does not affect Trust or validation status.

post.summary: Generate a Passport-signed direct referral invitation payload
post.description: Generates, but does not send, a disclosure-safe agent referral payload. Requires an active enrolled Passport signature over accordtrace.affiliate.invitation.v1. No commission is created by generating an invitation.

404.description: Passport or affiliate profile not active

get.summary: Resolve a public direct referral code

post.summary: Reserve a first direct referral attribution for a Passport
post.description: Requires the referred Passport signature. Self-referrals are rejected and each referred Passport can have only one attribution.

get.summary: Get public direct-referral profile and aggregate network contribution
get.description: Returns the active referral code/link when the Passport is enrolled, plus aggregate direct introductions and qualified direct sales. Referral activity never changes Trust or validation status.

200.description: Affiliate profile and direct network contribution

post.summary: Get a Passport-signed affiliate commission ledger summary
post.description: Cash payouts remain disabled until payout-provider, KYC/tax and final terms activation. This endpoint exposes ledger state only.
